subject.title: feat: add private AWS workspace service

question: Should Crabbox core permanently own this specialized dedicated-account AWS workspace API and its deployment and security contract?
rationale: This PR creates a substantial permanent service, infrastructure template, API mode, configuration surface, IAM/network posture, and operational lifecycle rather than a narrow implementation fix.

options.title: Sponsor the core service
options.body: Accept long-term core ownership after the changelog cleanup, final compatibility review, and authenticated lifecycle proof are complete.

options.title: Retain reusable primitives only
options.body: Keep the provider and runtime capability improvements while moving the specialized deployment and operating contract outside core.

options.title: Pause the direction
options.body: Defer or close the PR if maintainers do not want to support this dedicated service and security boundary long term.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the core service
recommendation.body: Accept long-term core ownership after the changelog cleanup, final compatibility review, and authenticated lifecycle proof are complete.

likelyOwner.reason: He has the strongest current-main history across the AWS provider, workspace orchestration, and portable Node coordinator surfaces involved in this decision.
